title: Add unified Terraform setup for multi-environment support
body:
### Descrição

Introduced a cohesive infrastructure-as-code setup for `production`, `sandbox`, and `staging` environments in Terraform, orchestrated via Atlantis. The configuration includes:

- Dynamic resource scaling and namespace management
- Modularized provisioning for DynamoDB, S3, SQS, and Lambda
- Separate backend configuration files for each environment
- Validation for workspace usage in staging

This setup enables efficient, declarative infrastructure management.

### Issue tracker

[VOP-1129](https://example.atlassian.net/browse/VOP-1129)

title: [VOP-1129] Add table prefixing support in configuration
body:
### Descrição

Allows dynamic table name prefixing based on environments like "development" and "staging." Introduced `TablePrefix` and updated table resolution logic through helper functions.

- Added `TablePrefix` to the `Config` struct
- Implemented `ResolveTableName` method for dynamic name resolution
- Updated tests to validate prefixing across environments
- Ensured production ignores prefixing to maintain fixed table names
